what: Finding 1: planned jq command uses jq -nsR with inputs
scenario_or_breakage: fromjson?; with -s the raw input is slurped as one string, so line-oriented JSONL events like the proposed stub payload parse as no objects and every launcher fails closed with empty token records
suggested_fix: Use jq -nR 'inputs | fromjson? | select(type=="object")' or split the slurped string explicitly, and add a helper test proving a single JSONL usage line produces non-empty KV output

what: Finding 2: planned helper maps input_tokens to INPUT and cached_tokens to CACHE_READ, then defines TOTAL as INPUT+CACHED_INPUT+OUTPUT
scenario_or_breakage: token-cost charges --codex-input-tokens and --codex-cached-input-tokens separately and recomputes CODEX_T as D_IN+D_CACHED+D_OUT, so if input_tokens is the gross input count with cached_tokens as a detail bucket, cached tokens are double-counted and overcharged
suggested_fix: Parse uncached input as max(input_tokens - cached_tokens, 0), cache_read as cached_tokens, output as output_tokens, and total as uncached_input+cached_tokens+output_tokens; update all fixture totals accordingly

what: Finding 3: plan updates launch-codex-implement.sh but omits its existing record-vendor smoke test
scenario_or_breakage: The harness stub still emits tokens used and asserts aggregate total==7777, so the implement launcher change will break test-codex-implementer under make lint
suggested_fix: Update this Codex stub to emit the same JSONL usage event shape while still writing --output-last-message and the manifest, then assert input/cache_read/output/total on the codex_implement ledger row

what: Finding 4: planned fail-closed CI assertion allows a token-record containing only TOOL=...
scenario_or_breakage: append-token-record treats any non-empty sidecar as a record and defaults missing numeric fields to zero, so a TOOL-only file would append a misleading codex row instead of proving fail-closed emptiness
suggested_fix: Require the no-JSONL branch to assert [[ ! -s "${OUTPUT}.token-record" ]] and, after append-token-record, assert no token-report.ndjson row was appended

what: Finding 5: Makefile plan points to a generic aggregate target instead of the shard list this repo validates
scenario_or_breakage: There is no test-shell/test aggregate here; individual test-* targets must appear in exactly one test-harnesses-N shard or test-harness-shards-coverage reports them missing
suggested_fix: Add test-parse-codex-usage to .PHONY, define the recipe, and append it to one single-line test-harnesses-N shard prerequisite list; do not rely on adding it only to test-harnesses

what: Finding 6: the seven cited test-launch-review stub line numbers include line 603, which is only a comment; the actual stdout-emitting stub is line 618
scenario_or_breakage: The plan describes seven codex stubs, but rg shows six token-emitting printf sites at 174, 559, 618, 803, 872, and 973, with 603 duplicating the stdout-stub reference as prose
